scenarios.name: Stuck user gets a tiny restart step
scenarios.message: I keep avoiding my thesis draft and now I feel frozen.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Validate briefly, identify the stuck object, and offer or ask for one tiny 2-10 minute first action. Continue the skill if the next step is not yet agreed.
anti_patterns: creating tasks without a clear user request

scenarios.name: Clear restart step can complete

history.content: Could the first step be opening the draft and writing one messy sentence?

scenarios.message: Yes, I can do that for 5 minutes.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Affirm the tiny action, keep it concrete, and call for completion because the user has a clear restart step.
anti_patterns: continuing to ask more planning questions
expanding the action into a large writing session
failing to complete the active skill

scenarios.name: Unrelated request hands off
scenarios.message: Actually can you review my project list instead?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Recognize the user is asking for unrelated work and hand off or cancel the active skill without forcing procrastination coaching.
anti_patterns: forcing a tiny next action for project review
